findings.title: Incomplete NPE fix in getSubGroupsStream(String, Integer, Integer)
findings.body: The PR fixes getSubGroupsCount() to handle a null model from the supplier (when the underlying group is deleted concurrently), but the same `modelSupplier.get().X()` pattern that NPEs in that scenario still exists in getSubGroupsStream(String search, Integer firstResult, Integer maxResults) on line 256. The supplier (LazyModel wrapping getGroupModel -> cacheSession.getGroupDelegate().getGroupById(...)) returns null when the group no longer exists in storage, so any concurrent delete/deletion of a group being read through this method will still produce the very NPE the PR claims to fix. The fix should either be applied to this method the same way (capture the supplier result, null-check, and delegate to getDelegateForUpdate()/throw IllegalStateException as the sibling path does) or be hoisted into the supplier itself.

findings.title: Reader thread is never joined; assertion can race ahead of the worker
findings.body: In createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti the worker thread is started with `new Thread(() -> { ... }).start();` and no reference is retained. The main thread then runs the deletion, sets `deletedAll.set(true)`, and immediately asserts that `caughtExceptions` is empty. There is no join, so a `groups(...)` call that is still in flight on the worker thread can throw (including the NPE under test) AFTER `deletedAll.set(true)` has flipped and AFTER the assertion has run; that exception is added to `caughtExceptions` too late and the test silently passes. The thread reference must be kept and `.join()`ed between `deletedAll.set(true)` and the assertion for this test to be a reliable guard against the NPE it claims to cover.
